name: Tsukumo Shizuku
source:
A genius and occult maniac.
This prodigious girl developed an interest in the occult due to her physicist mother's research.
Possessing extensive knowledge of supernatural phenomena and spirituality, she spends her days pursuing mysteries.
She often secludes herself in the Occult Research Club's room. Usually an elusive and mysterious presence, she occasionally exhibits enigmatic behaviors—such as writing bizarre passages as if possessed or conducting tarot card readings.
